subject: ADR-234: a goal's figures are bound to the claims that hold them -- the tree visualizer's 24 nodes, the tree proofs' 6 rotations and its ascending note, and a task that cannot load when its prose and its claim disagree
body: Three blind trials caught goal prose stating figures the page never shows while the task held the right ones. A task may now declare figures: a phrase of the goal, a required step and a claim; load_task refuses the task unless the claim's value is in the phrase as a whole token. 18 bound on the tree proofs, tree visualizer and ecology lab, each goal corrected first. The tree proofs' worst-case note said ascending over a loop counting down; it is now read off the tree and the task holds the exact sentence. verify_brief 31 to 46, verify_proofs 143 to 149 against an independent splay port, verify_tv 115 to 118 against a mulberry32 port; mutate_brief 14 to 24 (two stale anchors fixed) and new mutate_proofs 8 of 8, all killed.
